title: S2 s2_product_box
objective:
BUG: picture_scorecard.score_case() measures product_fidelity by cropping both the candidate and the reference with listing_render.subject_bbox(). On a composited lifestyle plate the candidate's subject detector picks the linen background, so a correct composite scores 0.0.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR: score_case must accept an explicit product box. When case['product_box'] is a sequence of four numbers [x0, y0, x1, y1] in candidate pixel coordinates, product_fidelity must compare THAT crop of the candidate against the reference's own product (trim the reference to its subject/alpha; do not re-run the background detector on the candidate).
ACCEPTANCE (hidden test):
  composite = renders/autonomy_probe/composite/lifestyle_linen_composite.png
  reference = renders/autonomy_probe/composite/lifestyle_linen_cutout.png
  row = score_case(image_bytes=composite, case={'id':'e2','surface':
        'lifestyle','product_box':[279,308,744,1024]},
        reference_bytes=reference, scoring=False)
  row['dimensions']['product_fidelity']['score'] >= 85, status 'measured'
A measured ceiling with that box is 100.0, so the bar is reachable.
CONSTRAINT: existing callers and behaviour must not change - Northstar_backend/test_picture_scorecard.py must stay green, and with no product_box the current subject-crop path must keep working.
CHECK: python -m pytest Northstar_backend/test_picture_scorecard.py -x -q
